import React from 'react'; import './WeatherApp.css'; const WeatherApp = () => { // Static data for now const currentWeather = { dateTime: 'Tuesday, 11:56', condition: 'Cloudy', temperature: '10°C', location: 'Kyiv, Ukraine', stats: { precipitation: '4.53 cm', daylight: '15 h 32 m', sunset: '8.13 pm' }, details: { rain: '90%', humidity: '73%', wind: '10 km/h' }, weeklyForecast: [ { day: 'Today', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Wed', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Thu', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Fri', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Sat', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Sun', high: '10°', low: '1°' }, { day: 'Mon', high: '10°', low: '1°' } ] }; return (
{currentWeather.dateTime}
{currentWeather.condition} {currentWeather.temperature}
{currentWeather.location}
{currentWeather.stats.precipitation}
Precipitation
{currentWeather.stats.daylight}
Daylight
{currentWeather.stats.sunset}
Sunset
Rain: {currentWeather.details.rain}
Humidity: {currentWeather.details.humidity}
Wind: {currentWeather.details.wind}
{currentWeather.weeklyForecast.map((day, index) => (
{day.day}
{day.high} {day.low}
))}
); }; export default WeatherApp;
